newsitem.title: USA: Labor's Herman says UPS, Teamster talks resume Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Labor's Herman says UPS, Teamster talks resume Thurs.

text.p: U.S. Labor Secretary Alexis Herman said Wednesday United Parcel Service and the Teamsters union will resume face-to-face talks on Thursday.
Labor's Herman says UPS, Teamster talks resume Thurs

"I am pleased both sides have agreed to go back to the bargaining table and I urge them to stay at the table until they reach a settlement," Herman said in a statement. "The key now is for both parties to find a new way to look at the issues and find a solution at the table."

Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service Director John Wells, who has conducted the past two rounds of talks in the 10-day-old strike by 184,000 Teamsters across the country, said he was glad the talks were resuming.
"I am very pleased that, following important individual meetings with Secretary of Labor Alexis Herman, union and company leaders have agreed to come back to the table," he said.
